claim: Netflix's 2025 Q3 period diluted EPS totaled $0.59.
summary: Netflix's 2025 Q3 diluted EPS was not $0.59. Based on model knowledge as of 2026-01-04, Netflix quarterly diluted EPS in 2024-2025 was consistently in the ~$4 to ~$6 range (FY2024 diluted EPS ~$19.83, Q3 2025 reported ~$5-6 even after a large Brazil tax provision). $0.59 is an order of magnitude too low, inconsistent with reported net income/revenue, and no stock split explains the difference, so the value claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Netflix had a reportable 2025 Q3 period
sub_claims.note: Netflix reports on standard calendar quarters; 2025 Q3 ended September 30, 2025, before the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's diluted EPS for the 2025 Q3 period totaled $0.59
sub_claims.note: Without tools, per model knowledge Netflix's quarterly diluted EPS in this period was approximately $5-6, not $0.59. Even the reduced GAAP EPS after the Q3 2025 Brazil-related tax provision was still ~$5+ on revenue >$11B and net income >$2B. $0.59 is materially and directionally incorrect and no disclosed split or restatement accounts for it.
